question: In which of the following Indian states is the Chhota Nagpur Plateau, located?
solution:
The correct answer is **Jharkhand**__**.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A large portion of **Jharkhand,** as well as adjacent regions of** Bihar, Odisha, West Bengal**, and **Chhattisgarh,** are included in the **Chhota Nagpur Plateau, an eastern Indian plateau.**
 
• To the **North and East of the plateau **are the **Indo-Gangetic Plains**, and to the **South is the Mahanadi River Basin**.
 
• **Precambrian rocks **make up the **Plateau**. The plateau was created by continental uplift brought on by forces that originated deep inside the earth.
 
• The** Rajmahal Hills, **which make up the **Chhota Nagpur Plateau's northern edge**, is primarily made of basalt and are covered in **basaltic lava flows.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The** Sanjay National Park in Chhattisgarh and the Palamau Tiger Reserve in Jharkhand **are nearby.
 
• A tropical and subtropical dry broadleaf forests ecoregion surrounds the plateau and is found in the** Chhota Nagpur.**
 
• Sal Trees are another prominent feature of the area. These trees are a good source of both food and lumber.
 
• The greatest concentration of mineral resources in India is located in the** Chhota Nagpur region**. Resources including bauxite, iron ore, and others are abundant in the area.
